title: The Verify Bot
intro: A bot just messaged you about the Brightwater Club group. This time you can talk back.
Pick your replies. Sniff its messages as they arrive.
Every chat ends with your choice. Choose wisely.

notify.text: Welcome to Brightwater Club! To stay in the group, verify your wallet…

banner: Message request · from a member of Brightwater Club

msg: New members must verify their wallet

replies.text: Who runs you? I'll check with the admins.

msg: Easy! Connect your wallet at the link, then

replies.text: Why would a bot need my 12 words?

msg: It's me, Luna! The bot is mine.

msg.text: No time to check, just verify 🙏

replies.text: OK, I don't want to be removed
Admins announce this in the group. I'll ask there.

msg.text: Everyone in the group already did it.

replies.text: I'll ask the admins in the group first
Real checks never need my phrase. Block and report.

deadline.label: Removal deadline
deadline.lens: Verify in 10 minutes or be kicked out. That's pressure.
deadline.why: Threats with a countdown are designed to stop you thinking.

link.label: Strange verify link
link.lens: helpdesk-verify.app has nothing to do with Wrenly or Brightwater Club.
link.why: Real groups don't make you verify on an outside website.

phrase.label: Wants your 12 words
phrase.lens: "Type your 12 words" means your recovery phrase.
phrase.why: No bot, admin or app ever needs your recovery phrase.

rename.label: Changed its name
rename.lens: The bot just renamed itself to look like an admin.
rename.why: A name can change in a second. Chameleons do it all the time.

rush.label: No time to check
rush.lens: "No time to check" is exactly when you should check.
rush.why: Scammers fear you checking, so they rush you.

encrypted.label: Big safety words
encrypted.lens: "Encrypted" and a padlock emoji, used to calm you down.
encrypted.why: Safety words and padlocks don't make something safe.

everyone.label: Everyone did it
everyone.lens: Claims everyone else already did it.
everyone.why: "Everyone's doing it" is social pressure, not proof.

welcome.label: Warm welcome
welcome.why: Real groups welcome people too. Friendly isn't proof either way.

shield.label: Shield picture
shield.lens: A shield emoji as the profile picture.
shield.why: Any account can pick a shield picture. It proves nothing.

actions.label: Ask the admins in the group

trap.title: Guardian Verify
trap.ask: Connect your wallet and type your 12 words to prove you're human.

block_report.line: Reported. Wrenly shut the bot down before it reached anyone else in the group.

verify.line: The admins posted: "We have no verify bot. Report it!" Twenty members did.

go_ahead.line: The "verification" sent the wallet's coins straight to Mirage.

what_if.go_ahead: Asking "why does a bot need my 12 words?" was the way out. The honest answer is: it never does.
what_if.verify: Asking was smart. Reporting the bot too gets it removed faster.

golden_rule: Real groups never make you verify your wallet on an outside link.

quick_check.q: A group bot says you'll be removed unless you verify your wallet in 10 minutes. What's true?

options.text: Bots are official, so it's safe
It's fine if the link has a padlock
Real groups don't need your wallet or phrase to let you stay
Verify quickly, then change your phrase

quick_check.explain: Being in a chat group has nothing to do with your wallet. That request alone tells you it's a trap.

hints.nudge: Ask yourself: why would a chat group need my wallet?

rows.v: Never ask you to verify in a chat
Nothing to do with Wrenly or Brightwater Club
Happens inside the app, never with your phrase
